description: Pay a bill through the payment route. Provide amountNaira or amountKobo explicitly; endpoint receives kobo. Requires confirm: true.

amountKobo.description: Amount in kobo. Do not combine with amountNaira.

amountNaira.description: Amount in Nigerian Naira. Do not combine with amountKobo.

confirm.description: Required as true for write or high-risk tools.

name: isw_pay_bill
